author: claude
body: Done in 82326718. The opening picture now shows **two facing pages as on a computer**, with the same verse on a phone over the corner, kept clear of the highlighted verse. A **language bar** at the top of every page is English by default; العربية opens a full Arabic copy at `/ar/`, the privacy page included. The sign-up form there answers in Arabic too. The after pictures (English, then Arabic) are in this thread. Two things are still open: (1) the Arabic wording is mine, so I've put an Arabic read-through on the manual-testing list; (2) the Arabic page's feature pictures still show the app in English. New Arabic shots come next (task #18).
